name: CLI / TUI
summary: The agent runs in the terminal as a command-line tool or full-screen text UI, reading and writing files and running commands in the user's working directory. Coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI use this form.
how: Ship the agent as a CLI installed on the user's machine
Read prompts from the terminal and stream output back
Run tools against the local filesystem and shell with permission prompts
Optionally offer a non-interactive mode for scripts and CI
facts: Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode
Ink (React for terminals), supported by assistant-ui
Many CLI agents also speak ACP to run inside editors
Direct local access, but limited visual UI
watchOut: Local commands need careful permission handling
